item.title: Paul Tazewell's designs for "Wicked" and "Hamilton" featured at Museum of Science and Industry
item.description: <p>In Paul Tazewell's Oscar-winning costumes for "Wicked," art meets science in the dark, mossy coils on Elphaba’s Emerald City dress. item.title: ‘The Chicago Way: An Oral History of Chicago Dining’ tells the story of the city's restaurant community
item.description: <p>As books about Chicago’s restaurant community go, “The Chicago Way: An Oral History of Chicago Dining” by Michael Gebert is a heavyweight — literally.</p><p>Close to five years in the making, the book (which is being published Feb. 2 by Evanston’s Agate Publishing) weighs almost 2 pounds.
